meta.title: About · Cosmic Studio, web studio in Geneva & Annecy
meta.description: Cosmic Studio is a web and mobile studio between Geneva and Annecy, run by Matthieu Compérat, who follows your project from the first chat to after launch.

about.title: A small studio, so your customers can find you.
about.lead: Cosmic Studio is Matthieu Compérat, a developer based in Chêne-Bougeries. He builds websites and apps for craftspeople, associations and independents, from Geneva to Annecy.

path.title: Fifteen years of development, one point of contact.
paragraphs: Matthieu comes from Duingt, on the shores of Lake Annecy, and has been building websites and apps for about fifteen years. He started out with large companies, where he learnt to build tools that are reliable and accessible to everyone.

With Cosmic Studio, he puts that experience to work for craftspeople, associations and independents. You talk to the person who builds your site, from the first call to the ongoing care, month after month.
path.linkedin_aria: Matthieu Compérat's LinkedIn profile (opens in a new tab)

why.title: Craftspeople and associations deserve better than a template.
why.lead: Large agencies mostly work for large companies, and online site builders leave you to figure the tool out on your own. Cosmic Studio is for everyone in between.

found.title: Get found close to home
found.description: Your customers look for you on their phones, a few kilometres away. A fast, well-built site ranks better on Google.

price.title: A price that follows your business
price.description: A subscription from {price} a month excl. VAT that evolves with you, rather than a large upfront investment.

answer.title: Someone who answers
answer.description: No call centre: the person who built your site is the one who answers, usually the same day.

ai.title: AI to save time, always reviewed
ai.description: We use artificial intelligence to work faster, and a person reviews everything it produces. The details are in our legal notice.

cta.title: Let's work together.
cta.description: Tell us about your business in a few lines. Matthieu replies quickly.
